introText: Our Kampong Speu site includes office, factory, warehouse and accommodation areas. This page introduces their roles at a high level. The images are AI-created illustrations of noodle manufacturing, not photographs or evidence of equipment installed at our site.

capabilitiesText: We are developing instant noodle manufacturing operations. Verified production capacity, equipment lists and product specifications will be published after company review.
qualityText: Clear procedures and careful daily work are part of our approach. Any formal quality standards or certifications will be listed here only after they are confirmed.
safetyText: We want practical, responsible work practices that support the teams operating and maintaining the site.
